findings.location: EN L291 Figure 2 legend (b) / JP L319 同 — EN: "coincide with the fall in relative arm coverage from 2.26 to 1.13"; JP: 「アームの相対カバレッジが2.26から1.13へ低下した」
findings.issue: 2.26 -> 1.13 is the CORE/ARM coverage ratio; its fall means relative ARM coverage ROSE. As written the legend says arm coverage fell, which would predict FEWER arm sites at T2, the opposite of the 232 arm-skewed T2-only sites it is invoked to explain. EN and JP carry the same error (parity preserved, both wrong).
findings.evidence: Supp Fig 17 legend EN L415: "Core/arm coverage ratio across timepoints (T1 2.26, T2 1.13, T3 1.19)"; R1 EN L51: core/arm ratio falls 2.26 (T1) -> 1.13 (T2) because oriC is in the core. Table: 90_per_timepoint_census_audit/README.md line 60 (SuppFigure17 coverage control).
findings.proposed_fix: EN: "...coincide with the rise in relative arm coverage at T2 (core/arm coverage ratio 2.26 -> 1.13; Supplementary Figure 17), so they cannot be separated from increased detection power in the arms"; mirror in JP (「core/arm カバレッジ比が2.26から1.13へ低下し、アームの相対カバレッジが上昇する」).

findings.location: EN L399 Supp Fig 13 legend (b) / JP L429 — "1,514 (98.95%) carry the mark on the same strand in every library"
findings.issue: (i) No named table in the analysis repo reports 1,530 / 1,514 / 98.95% (grep over non-archived tables/READMEs finds none). (ii) The stated definition does not reproduce the number: recomputing from the source pileup table, the eligible set is exactly 1,530, but 'same methylated strand (>=50%) in every library in which methylated' gives 1,526 (99.74%); 'never methylated on the other strand' gives 1,505 (98.37%); 1,514 (98.95%) is obtained only as 'the HIGHER-FREQUENCY strand is the same in every library'.
findings.evidence: Recomputed in 102_post_edit_parity from 91_comod_stratified_and_hemi/tables/REFA06_GCCGGC_per_instance_strand_pct.tsv.gz (8 pileups 1-1,1-2,1-3,2-1,2-3,3-2,3-3,3-4): n eligible (methylated >=50% in >=3 libraries) = 1530; nunique(strand label)==1 -> 1526 (99.74%); union of methylated strands size 1 -> 1505 (98.37%); majority-strand fixed -> 1514 (98.95%).
findings.proposed_fix: Either reword to "...1,514 (98.95%) show the same higher-frequency strand in every library in which they are methylated", or keep the current wording and use 1,526 (99.74%). Deposit the counts as a named table (e.g. 91_/tables/REFA06c_cross_library_strand_identity.tsv) and cite it.

findings.location: EN L274 Limitations / JP L303 — "the title and Abstract are phrased accordingly (\"orthogonal chemical confirmation pending\")"
findings.issue: The Abstract carries the qualifier, but the title does not: it reads '...a 4mC/6mA methylome with a same-strand AAGCCCG dual modification' with no pending-confirmation wording. The Limitations paragraph asserts a hedge in the title that is not there.
findings.evidence: EN L16 Abstract: "...orthogonal chemical confirmation pending"; EN L1 title has no such clause. JP identical (JP L14 「直交的な化学的確認は保留中」; JP L1 title none).
findings.proposed_fix: Change to "the Abstract is phrased accordingly" in both files, or add the qualifier to the title if the authors want it there.

findings.location: EN L274 Limitations / JP L303 — "in the CCGG context that matches GCCGGC, 0 of 334 genuine-5mC observations were called 4mC"
findings.issue: The paragraph quotes the favourable CCGG-context row of Supp Table 11 (genuine 5mC, 0/334) but omits the unfavourable CCGG-context row of the same table: unmodified C in CCGG context was called 4mC in 4 of 51 observations (7.8%) at >=0.5, higher than the 4.7% genome-wide figure that IS reported. The categorical conclusion "would thus have been reported as 5mC, not 4mC" also rests on 0/334 (Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound ~1.1%).
findings.evidence: 92_d6_5mC_misassignment_control/tables/SuppTable11_5mC_misassignment_control.tsv: row canonical_C_CCGG_context, threshold 0.5, n_obs 51, called_4mC 4, frac_4mC 0.07843; row true_5mC_CCGG_context 334 obs, called_4mC 0. All other Limitations numbers check out against this table (18,010; 0.009; 0.00067; 0.9286; 8,925; 0.04706; 0.00459; 0.00426).
findings.proposed_fix: Add one clause: "(in the same context, 4 of 51 unmodified-C observations were called 4mC at >= 0.5, 0 of 51 at >= 0.9 — see Supplementary Table 11)" and soften to "...would have been reported as 5mC in this control, at a false-4mC rate bounded by 0 of 334 observations (95% CI 0-1.1%)". Mirror in JP.

findings.location: EN L399 Supp Fig 13 legend (a) / JP L429 — "(vs 4.87% of GCCGGC modified C)" / 「(GCCGGC修飾Cの4.87%に対して)」
findings.issue: The comparator 4.87% has no stated denominator and no source table; it sits immediately before the newly edited 13b clause. Unclear whether it is the fraction of genomic GCCGGC cytosines called 4mC-positive or a mean modification frequency.
findings.evidence: Grep for '4.87' across non-archived analysis tables returns only unrelated gene-feature columns (52_shielded_exposed_boundary/tables/all_genes_features*.tsv); no specificity table reports it. Related non-motif numbers (0 of 6.14 M, 2 at >=25%, 102 at >=10%) are consistent with Limitations' "0 of 6.1 x 10^6" and "~0.003%".
findings.proposed_fix: State the denominator explicitly (e.g. "4.87% of the 32,118 genomic GCCGGC cytosines reach freq >= 50%") and cite the producing table, or drop the comparator.
